description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the comprehensive video enhancement feature EnhanceVideoQuality
description_zh: 本文介绍视频综合增强EnhanceVideoQuality的语法及示例
name: EnhanceVideoQuality

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input video. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS link is not in the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The width of the output video. Default value: twice the width of the input video. Unit: px. Valid values: `[180,7680]`
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的宽，默认为输入2倍，单位为px，取值范围`[180,7680]`
parameters.name: out_put_width

parameters.help_en: The height of the output video. Default value: twice the height of the input video. Unit: px. Valid values: `[180,4320]`
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的高，默认为输入2倍，单位为px，取值范围`[180,4320]`
parameters.name: out_put_height

parameters.help_en: The frame rate of the output video. Default value: 50 fps. Valid values: `[1,120]`
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的帧率，默认50帧，取值范围`[1,120]`
parameters.name: frame_rate

parameters.help_en: The HDR format of the output video. Only PQ and HLG are supported. Default value: PQ
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的HDR格式，仅支持PQ和HLG两种格式，默认为PQ
parameters.name: hdr_format

parameters.help_en:
The maximum luminance of the output video. Unit: nit.

In PQ mode, this parameter is fixed at 600 nit and the input value is ignored.
In HLG mode, valid values of this parameter range from 500 nit to 1000 nit. Default value: 1000 nit
parameters.help_zh:
输出视频最大亮度，单位为nit。

在PQ模式下该参数固定为600nit，输入无效。
在HLG模式下该参数取值范围为500nit~1000nit，默认1000nit
parameters.name: max_illuminance

parameters.help_en: The bitrate of the output video. Unit: MB. Default value: 20 MB. Valid values: `[8,200]`
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频码率，单位为MB，默认20MB，取值范围`[8,200]`
parameters.name: bitrate

Data.description_en: The returned result data. You can obtain this data by calling the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation after the asynchronous task is complete, and then deserializing the Result field from JSON
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoURL.description_en:
The URL of the processed video.
This URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. After the URL expires, you can no longer access it. To store the file for an extended period, download the file within 30 minutes and save it to your OSS bucket or other storage
VideoURL.description_zh:
处理后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
